plan.title: Research plan
plan.advancedDisclosureHint: Assumptions, deliverable, completion criteria, and budget
plan.reconDisclosure: Planning reconnaissance sends the research question to the configured public search service. Its snippets inform the plan only and are not report evidence.

reconStatus.partial: Reconnaissance completed with incomplete results; source feasibility is not fully verified.
reconStatus.unavailable: Reconnaissance was unavailable; source feasibility has not been verified.

plan.empty: The research plan is being prepared. No sources have been contacted yet.

planStep.searchingDetail: Searching for evidence for this research step.
planStep.pendingDetail: Evidence will appear here as research progresses.

run.selectNode: Expand a research node to inspect its evidence and learnings.
run.queryPending: The query will be generated when this node enters the frontier.
run.scopeApproval: This direction expands the approved source or research scope and requires approval before access.
run.scopeResume: This saved task found additional research directions. Resume to continue from committed evidence without rebuilding the plan.
run.claimWarning: {conflicts} conflicting and {unresolved} unresolved claims remain visible for verification.

stop.no_new_sources: No new formal evidence or verified findings across two consecutive waves
stop.invalid_model_output: The model returned an invalid research packet
stop.no_new_verified_claims: No new verified claims across consecutive waves
stop.frontier_exhausted: No viable in-scope research nodes remain

settings.title: Deep Research settings
settings.futureTasksOnly: These session defaults apply to new research tasks. Existing plans and active runs do not change.
settings.budgetDescription: The preset limits model rounds, tool calls, and total run time.
settings.strategyDescription: The generated plan starts with these limits and can still be adjusted before approval.

sourceScope.label: Approved source scope
sourceScope.searchWarning: Web search is not available in this source scope. Enable a compatible external search provider before starting.

adjust.title: Adjust research plan
adjust.label: Describe the change
adjust.help: A new plan version will be created and must be confirmed before research resumes.
adjust.placeholder: For example, compare the last three years and prioritize primary sources.
adjust.error: The plan could not be updated. Your instruction is still available to retry.

strategyAdjust.title: Advanced research strategy
strategyAdjust.help: Saving creates an immutable plan version without rerunning planning reconnaissance.
strategyAdjust.error: The strategy could not be saved. Your values remain available to retry.

card.reportAvailable: Report version {version} is available in the workbench
card.replyHint: Reply in the chat to refine this plan, or start the research when it looks right.

taskList.title: Deep Research
taskList.description: Plans, evidence, and reports for this chat
taskList.emptyDescription: Return to the chat, enable Deep Research, and ask the first question you want to investigate.

workbench.notFound: This research task is unavailable or was removed.

activity.title: Research activity
activity.empty: Activity will appear here after the plan is confirmed.
activity.noSourceBeforeApproval: Before approval, only bounded public search summaries may be used for planning reconnaissance; source bodies cannot become report evidence.
activity.toolSafeDetail: Read-only operation; raw arguments and results are hidden.
activity.degradedWaveDetail: {count} research nodes produced no valid learning packet. Preserved evidence remains available and the report will continue with explicit gaps.
activity.scopeExpansionDetail: {count} additional research directions will continue from committed evidence in this run.
activity.scopeExpansionLimitedDetail: {count} directions require sources that are unavailable in this conversation and will remain explicit report gaps.

report.emptyDescription: The full report will appear here after evidence has been collected, verified, and synthesized.
report.artifactUnavailable: The local report artifact is unavailable.
report.continueChangeSummary: This version continues the previous investigation with an approved follow-up plan.
report.updateChangeSummary: This version refreshes mutable sources and records the latest available state.

evidence.title: Evidence inspector
evidence.emptyDescription: Evidence will appear here as each research step advances.
evidence.unlinkedClaim: Not yet linked to a formal claim.

ask.title: Ask the existing evidence
ask.label: Question
ask.help: This uses only the evidence already collected. It will not access the network or create a report version.
ask.placeholder: What does the evidence say about the main disagreement?

continue.title: Continue the research
continue.label: Additional research goal
continue.help: This creates a new plan for confirmation and can produce a new report version.
continue.placeholder: Investigate the unresolved claim using additional primary sources.

followup.error: The request could not be submitted. Your text is still available to retry.

slot.question: Another research task is active in this browser tab. What should happen before starting this one?
slot.pauseDescription: Save a safe checkpoint and start the new task.
slot.cancelDescription: Stop the current task permanently and start the new task.
slot.returnDescription: Do not start another research task.

notice.planReady: Deep Research plan is ready for approval.
notice.reportPartial: Deep Research finished with evidence gaps.
notice.evidenceAnswer: Answer added to the research chat using stored evidence only.

error.plan: Failed to prepare the Deep Research plan.
error.report: Deep Research could not finish the report.
error.planFallback: Failed to prepare the research plan.
error.budgetFallback: The research budget was exhausted before a defensible report could be saved.
error.activeTaskKept: The current Deep Research task was kept, so no new task was created.
error.chatMissing: The chat for this Deep Research task is no longer available.
error.taskMissing: The Deep Research task is unavailable in this chat.
error.persistence: Deep Research cannot continue because durable browser storage is unavailable.

gaps.noEvidence: No retrievable source evidence was committed.
gaps.noKeyFindings: The report did not contain an auditable Key findings section.
gaps.sourceOperations: {count} source operations could not be completed.
gaps.searchOnly: {count} search results remained discovery-only because no full source body was committed.
gaps.unsupportedClaims: {count} key findings could not be mapped to committed evidence.
gaps.unresolvedConflicts: {count} claims still have unresolved supporting and contradicting evidence.
gaps.incompleteQuestions: {count} approved research steps remain partial or unanswered.
gaps.scopeExpansionUnavailable: {count} expanded research directions required sources that were unavailable in this conversation.
gaps.executionInterrupted: The research run ended before every planned operation completed; this report preserves the defensible material already produced.
gaps.budget: The approved research budget was exhausted.

dependency.offline: Network research is unavailable while this browser is offline. Reconnect, then resume manually.
dependency.modelUnavailable: The approved research model is unavailable. Choose an available compatible model and prepare a new plan.
dependency.toolCallingUnavailable: The approved research model no longer supports Tool Calling. Choose a compatible model and prepare a new plan.
dependency.searchUnavailable: The approved search source is no longer available. Restore its configuration or adjust the plan.
dependency.searchDisabled: Web search is not available in this source scope. Enable a compatible external search provider and prepare a new plan.
dependency.leaseConflict: Another browser tab is running this chat. Return to that tab or retry after it finishes.
dependency.checkpointUnavailable: The interrupted Agent run is unavailable, so committed calls cannot be replayed safely. Keep the task paused or prepare a new plan.
dependency.sourceUnavailable: The approved source "{source}" is no longer available. Restore it or adjust the plan.

legacy.cleared: This legacy Deep Research record was cleared during the v2 upgrade.
